text.en: No. S. 120.-THE CoNSTITUTION OF THE STATE OF BRUNEI, 1959. [Notification under section 1 {2) ] In exercise of the powers conferred upon him by subsection (2) of section 1 of the Constitution, His Highness the S. 97 of 1959. Sultan has appointed the 18th October, 1959, as the date for the coming into force of PARTS IV, V, VI and VII of the Constitution of the State of Brunei, 1959. By Command. HAJJ IBRAHIM BIN MOHD. .JAHFAR, M entri Besar1 Brunei.
